newsitem.title: USA: Trimedyne gets FDA clearance on laser.
newsitem.headline: Trimedyne gets FDA clearance on laser.

text.p: Trimedyne Inc said on Monday that it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market its new cosmetic laser.
In addition to marketing clearance for aesthetic (cosmetic) surgical use, the new laser was cleared for sale for therapeutic use in plastic and dermatological surgery.
The company said it plans to introduce the new laser at plastic and aesthetic surgery association meetings in May 1997, and shipments are expected to commence in June or July 1997.
The company said that until its market release, it is not disclosing its unique cosmetic surgery applications.
